List directory contents recursively, with metadata

Source: R/fs-parity.R
dir_info.Rd

List directory contents recursively, with metadata

Usage

dir_info(path = ".", con = NULL, type = "any", recurse = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

path

A local or remote path. For dir_ls(), a connection supplied as the first argument is shorthand for listing that connection's root.

con

NULL for local fs behavior, or a netfs connection.

type

One or more of fs::file_info()'s type levels (e.g. "file", "directory") to filter the listing to; "any" (the default) returns everything. An entry whose type can't be determined never matches a specific type. Filtering by type, like recurse, costs one extra request per entry on backends that don't return type with the listing itself.

recurse

Recurse fully into subdirectories?

...

Arguments passed to fs::dir_ls() locally or to the backend.

Value

Locally, the result of fs::dir_info(). Remotely, the same tibble shape as file_info(), one row per entry.
